title: API Security Best Practices
content: API security includes authentication using OAuth2, role-based authorization, strict input validation, and rate limiting to prevent abuse and DDoS attacks.

title: FastAPI Architecture Overview
content: FastAPI is a modern, high-performance web framework for building APIs with Python based on standard type hints. It provides automatic interactive documentation using Swagger UI.

title: Vector Embeddings Fundamentals
content: Vector embeddings represent text as dense numerical arrays in a multi-dimensional space, capturing semantic meaning and contextual relationships between words and sentences.

title: Cosine Similarity Metric
content: Cosine similarity measures the cosine of the angle between two non-zero vectors in an inner product space, determining how closely aligned two vectors are in semantic space.

title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation RAG
content: RAG enhances Large Language Models by retrieving relevant external documents and injecting them into the prompt context to generate accurate, grounded, and citable answers.

title: Document Chunking Strategies
content: Document chunking breaks large files into smaller overlapping segments to ensure precise retrieval relevance and fit within token limits without losing conversational context.

title: Database Indexing Performance
content: Indexing databases improves retrieval speed by creating pointers to data locations, drastically reducing query execution time for large-scale enterprise applications.

title: Cloud Deployment Guidelines
content: Cloud deployments require containerization using Docker, environment variable separation for secrets, health check endpoints, and automated CI/CD pipeline integration.

title: Asynchronous Programming in Python
content: Asyncio enables concurrent Python code execution using async and await syntax, highly beneficial for handling I/O-bound network requests in web applications like FastAPI.

title: Automated Testing with Pytest
content: Pytest is a robust testing framework for Python that supports fixtures, parameterized testing, mocking with unittest.mock, and seamless TestClient integration for web APIs.

title: Prompt Engineering and Grounding
content: Prompt grounding forces LLMs to rely strictly on provided context documents, mitigating hallucinations and ensuring responses are verifiable against source material.

title: Handling API Rate Limits
content: Rate limiting protects backend services by restricting the number of requests a client can make within a specified time window, returning HTTP 429 status upon excess.

title: Microservices Communication Patterns
content: Microservices communicate via REST APIs, gRPC, or message brokers like RabbitMQ and Kafka, ensuring decoupled architecture and independent scalability.

title: Environment Variable Security
content: Sensitive configuration keys like API tokens and database credentials must never be hardcoded; they should be loaded securely via .env files and environment variables.

title: Data Validation with Pydantic
content: Pydantic enforces data parsing and type safety in Python using modern type annotations, automatically validating incoming payloads and returning clear 422 error details.

title: Error Handling and Logging
content: Proper error handling catches exceptions gracefully, maps them to standard HTTP status codes, and avoids exposing internal stack traces or database errors to clients.

title: LLM Hallucination Mitigation
content: Hallucinations occur when generative models fabricate facts; combining low temperature settings with robust RAG retrieval significantly reduces false outputs.

title: Semantic Search vs Keyword Search
content: Keyword search matches exact word tokens, whereas semantic search understands intent and synonyms via vector embeddings, capturing conceptual similarity.

title: CI/CD Pipeline Automation
content: Continuous Integration and Continuous Deployment pipelines automate automated testing, code linting, security scanning, and production releases upon git commits.

title: API Health Monitoring and Metrics
content: Health check endpoints (/health) verify core service dependencies such as database connectivity, model API availability, and memory readiness for load balancers.
